invention_title: 一种大语言模型智能体的工具调用控制方法及系统
toolchain: xelatex (TeX Live) + ctex/xeCJK + TikZ + pdfpages; 单一来源在 patent/tex/，PDF 由 patent/tex/build.cjs 编译
external_review_skipped_reason: codex MCP server failed to connect (-32000 Connection closed); /patent-review not executed
prior_art_source: applicant-supplied, not independently verified by this tool
phase_1_note: prior art search + novelty assessment were performed by the applicant before this run and recorded verbatim in patent/tex/notes-prior-art.tex; A2 folded into claim 1 + claims 6-8, A3 and B5 deferred
blocking_risk: applicant's own public disclosure on 2026-09-13 (origin/0.4.69, commit fedd467f); CN Patent Law Art.24 grace period does NOT apply to self-publication on a code hosting platform

combined.note: 非递交件，仅供通读与存档

checks.missing_characters: pass (0; 缺字会让字符在 PDF 里静默消失，故当作构建失败)
checks.figure_numeral_cross_check: pass (12 个标记，说明书与五幅附图双向一致)
checks.markdown_to_latex_equivalence: pass (迁移时逐字比对 6 份文档全部一致，比对脚本用后即删)
checks.cnipa_form_requirements: pass (依据官网通用类 100001--100004 表格快照与专利审查指南 2023（2025 年修订），见 patent/docs/CNIPA-TEMPLATE.md)
checks.page_margins: pass (正文左/上 25mm，右/下至少 15mm；实测页码下沿距纸边 15.403mm)
checks.glyph_height_mm: pass (正文 SimSun 字框实测 4.233mm，当前指南要求不低于 3.5mm)
checks.page_number_position: pass (各文件分别从 1 编号，纸张左右居中；页码下沿距纸边 15.403mm)
checks.description_first_line: pass (跳过页眉后第一行正文是发明名称；页眉保留官方“说明书”框题)
checks.abstract_elements: pass (名称/领域/问题/要点/用途 五项齐全)
checks.orphan_headings:
pass (
eedspace 硬约束 + pdftotext 复查，已反向验证闸门有效)

electronic_submission: 自 2026-01-01 起电子办理须提交符合 CNIPA 数据标准的 XML，PDF/Word 仅作纸面核对或对应附件，见官网 2025-11-12 XML 通知。
filing_order: 请求书(官方表格,未生成) → 说明书摘要 → 摘要附图 → 权利要求书 → 说明书 → 说明书附图（专利审查指南第一部分第一章）
known_deviation: 背景技术未引证现有技术文献号（审查指南 2.2.3 要求尽可能引证）。原因：检索结果由申请人提供、未独立复核；文献清单在 notes-prior-art，待代理人核实后决定是否补入。
